target.definition: log nominal Henry Hub spot price at t+1
target.evaluation_value: BHLR 2024M2 column, numerically stable for non-revised Henry Hub history

chronology.excluded_from_research: all origins from 2020-09 onward; existing rep-014 sealed window begins 2020-09

A_market_only: current-vintage log nominal Henry Hub spot price at origin
models.curve_state: omitted: governed long history does not cover the full 1997-2020 contract; issue-authorized AR/seasonal fallback used
B_realized_physical_additions: log dry natural gas production at origin from BHLR final vintage
log working natural gas storage at origin from BHLR final vintage
log total natural gas consumption at origin from BHLR final vintage
C_pit_substitutions: log dry production from the origin-vintage BHLR column including source-study nowcast
log working storage from the origin-vintage BHLR column including source-study nowcast
log total consumption from the origin-vintage BHLR column including source-study nowcast
models.C_fit_rule: reuse each origin's fitted B scaler and ridge coefficients exactly; replace only the three physical prediction inputs; no C refit

source_semantics.vintage_columns: 1991M1 through 2024M2, one column per origin month
source_semantics.dry_production: MER Table 4.1; 1/2/3 month delay; ALD source-study nowcast; revised
source_semantics.working_storage: MER Table 4.4; 1/2/3 month delay; prior-year month-on-month-change source-study nowcast; revised
source_semantics.total_consumption: MER Table 4.3; 1/3 month delay; same-month-prior-year source-study nowcast; revised

evaluation.A_to_B_survive: relative RMSE improvement >= 0.01; primary MBB lower 95% CI > 0; non-negative RMSE improvement in at least two chronological thirds
evaluation.A_to_B_fail: stop without C; physical mechanism remains explanatory only / rules out material predictive benefit under this contract
evaluation.B_to_C_preserve: C retains at least 50% of B's A-relative improvement and C clears the A-relative primary survival rule
evaluation.B_to_C_information_kill: C loses at least 50% of B's A-relative improvement or C no longer clears the A-relative primary survival rule

guardrails: no Programme-002 sealed confirmation outcome access
no feature/model/hyperparameter/threshold changes after this freeze
C changes only physical prediction inputs under B coefficients
